blind.description: An organic alien cluster consisting of four pale green, veiny egg-like pods nestled around a central hollow vent or ruptured pod. The pods are bound together by wrinkly, grey fleshy webbing that forms a flat skirt on the floor. On one side, the fleshy mound features two glossy black bulbous eye-like structures above an open orifice, creating a grotesque face. Surfaces are solid, fleshy, and continuous without hovering artifacts or visible mesh errors. Colors consist of pale yellowish-green with dark vein patterns on the pods, mottled greyish-tan flesh on the base and rim, and glossy black eyes.
blind.from_above: Resembles a rounded four-lobed clover or paw print formed by four green textured orbs surrounding a central open dark hollow rimmed in pale flesh.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1.5 ft tall) and about 2 to 2.5 ft wide.
